# One article URL per line. Optionally follow it with the issue or journal URL
# used to warm the browser. Add a fixture name in a trailing # comment.
# Format: ARTICLE_URL [ISSUE_OR_JOURNAL_URL] [# fixture_name]
# If the article URL contains /journal/<slug>/ or /bookseries/<slug>/, the warm
# URL can be omitted and will be derived as the journal issues/bookseries volumes page.
# Canonical /science/article/pii/... URLs do not contain that slug, so they need
# the second URL.
# foreign_title_and_abstract
# bookseries_chapter_editor
# article_id_no_pages
# richtext_sub_and_superscript

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2214567225000997 https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/revue-veterinaire-clinique/vol/61/issue/2 # foreign_title_and_abstract
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/chapter/bookseries/pii/S0065308X26000023 https://www.sciencedirect.com/bookseries/advances-in-parasitology/vol/131/suppl/C # bookseries_chapter_editor
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2214109X26001361 https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/the-lancet-global-health/vol/14/issue/6 # article_id_no_pages
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1002016025000335 https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/pedosphere/vol/36/issue/3 # richtext_sub_and_superscript
